Small display fix on top of [1.0.0](https://github.com/pioacosta/PKTool/releases/tag/v1.0.0).

**Download `PKTool.nds` below** and replace the old one on your SD card. Your saves, backups, Bank and settings stay as they are.

## Changes

- Money is shown in yen, like in the games: **¥400,406** instead of $ 400,406 (trainer card and save menu).
- The comma of the small font has a tail now, so thousands no longer look like decimals ("400,406" used to read as "400.406"). This also fixes commas in every other text.
